asserts which interpreter behavior variables the evidence child sees. The staged suite sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE for its children, so the staged full suite on Python 3.13 saw ['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] where the checkout run of the same revision saw none. The test reads the staged variable set now.
